scenarios.title: A player with no speed who controls a start your engines permanent gets speed 1
decisions: A casts Burnout Bashtronaut (R), tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Burnout Bashtronaut resolves and the next state-based check is performed.

variants.label: start_your_engines
variants.expected: Burnout Bashtronaut enters the battlefield. In the state-based check A's speed becomes 1. B still has no speed.

variants.label: no_keyword
variants.delta: A casts Grizzly Bears (1G), tapping both Forests, instead of Burnout Bashtronaut.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears enters the battlefield. A still has no speed. B still has no speed.

variants.label: already_has_speed
variants.delta: A already has speed 3 before casting Burnout Bashtronaut.
variants.expected: Burnout Bashtronaut enters the battlefield. A's speed stays 3.

scenarios.title: Speed rises when an opponent loses life during your turn

setup.notes: A's speed is 1 (A has had speed since Burnout Bashtronaut entered). B has no speed. It is A's turn. A's speed has not increased yet this turn.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: opponent_loses_life
variants.expected: B loses 2 life (life 18). The speed trigger fires and A's speed becomes 2.

variants.label: creature_target
variants.delta: Shock targets B's Grizzly Bears instead of player B.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard. B's life stays 20. The speed trigger does not fire and A's speed stays 1.

variants.label: max_speed
variants.expected: B loses 2 life (life 18). The speed trigger does not fire and A's speed stays 4.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: It is B's turn (B is the active player, main1) instead of A's turn; A casts Shock at instant speed.
variants.expected: B loses 2 life (life 18). The speed trigger does not fire and A's speed stays 1.

scenarios.title: The speed trigger happens only once each turn

setup.notes: A's speed is 1. B has no speed. It is A's turn. A's speed has not increased yet this turn.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping a Mountain.
A casts a second Shock targeting player B, tapping the other Mountain.
Both players pass; the second Shock resolves.

variants.label: same_turn
variants.expected: B loses 2 life twice (life 16). The speed trigger fires after the first Shock only: A's speed becomes 2 and stays 2 after the second Shock.

variants.label: next_turn
variants.delta: The second Shock is cast on A's next turn instead of the same turn (A's Mountains untap, A's speed stays 2 in between).
variants.expected: B loses 2 life twice (life 16). The speed trigger fires on each of the two turns: A's speed becomes 2 after the first Shock and 3 after the second.

scenarios.forge_notes: The next_turn variant spans two of A's turns.

scenarios.title: A player with no speed counts as speed 0 for an effect that compares speed

setup.notes: A has no speed. B has speed 2. Spikeshell Harrier's enters trigger returns target creature an opponent controls to hand, then if that opponent's speed is greater than each other player's speed, reduces it by 1 (never below 1).

decisions: A casts Spikeshell Harrier (4U), tapping five Islands.
Both players pass; Spikeshell Harrier resolves.
Its enters trigger targets B's Grizzly Bears; both players pass and the trigger resolves.

variants.label: no_speed_counts_as_zero
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand. B's speed becomes 1. A still has no speed.

variants.label: equal_speed
variants.delta: A has speed 2 instead of no speed.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand. B's speed stays 2. A's speed stays 2.
